lines.text: Each day, one unblemished year-old male lamb is offered in the morning and the other at noon.
At each new moon, two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs are offered, plus one male goat as a sin offering.
The fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD's Passover, and for seven days unleavened bread is eaten.
On the first day of the seventh month, Israel holds a sacred assembly and sounds the cymbals.
On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, a seven-day feast begins with thirteen young bulls offered on the first day.
